# Data Model

## AS IS — Current state

### Entities

Source: 70 migrations in `database/migrations`, models in `app/Models`.

| Entity | Notes |
|---|---|
| `users` | Owners/admins; soft deletes; `notify_video_ready`; Cashier customer columns; role → `roles` |
| `restaurants` | fillable: plan_id, status_id, name, description, slug, logo_path, cover_path, accent_color, font, menu_style, qr_settings, business_type; soft deletes; Billable (Cashier) |
| `categories` | belongs to restaurant; `display_order`; visibility |
| `dishes` | restaurant_id, category_id, status_id, active_video_id, name, price, short_description, description, display_order |
| `dish_variants`, `dish_photos`, `badges` + `badge_dish` pivot | Dish children |
| `videos` | dish video; status, origin, `mux_asset_id`, playback id, `duration_seconds`, cover photo path, retention columns |
| `video_generations` | dish_id, preset_id, provider_id, status_id, variations_requested, custom_prompt, provider operations |
| `video_generation_photos` | generation_id, dish_photo_id, angle_order |
| `generation_balances` | per restaurant: monthly_balance, addon_balance, renews_at |
| `generation_ledger` | restaurant_id, type_id, quantity, reference, amount_cents |
| `plans` | dish_limit, monthly_generations, price_cents, stripe_price_id, metrics level, first-subscription bonus, is_active |
| `video_addon_packages`, `coupons` | add-on packs; platform billing coupons |
| `subscriptions`, `subscription_items` | Cashier |
| `ai_providers`, `ai_presets` | provider/preset config for generation |
| `dish_views` | restaurant_id, dish_id, session_token, viewed_on, seconds_watched; unique per (dish, session, day) |
| `monthly_costs`, `admin_logs`, `support_tickets`, `support_ticket_messages`, `notifications` | Ops, support, notifications |
| `restaurant_order_settings`, `business_hours`, `delivery_zones`, `delivery_distance_tiers` | Per-store ordering settings (WhatsApp, Pix, timezone, delivery mode `a_combinar|bairro|distancia`, lat/lng), weekly hours, neighborhoods, km ranges |
| `option_groups`, `options`, `dish_option_group` | Complements; `pizza_sizes`, `pizza_flavors`, `pizza_flavor_prices`; `dishes` gained `sale_type`, `kind`, `promo_price`, `promo_ends_at`, `is_featured`; `promo_banners` |
| `orders`, `order_items`, `order_payments`, `order_status_history`, `customers` | Orders (money in `decimal(10,2)`, item snapshot, `tracking_token`, origin/campaign, coupon, loyalty and courier links); personal data purged by `orders:prune-personal-data` and `customers:prune-inactive` |
| `cash_sessions`, `cash_movements`, `receivables` | Caixa (one open session per store via virtual unique column; `cash_movements.reference` unique for idempotency); fiado |
| `promo_codes`, `loyalty_programs`, `loyalty_cards`, `funnel_events` | Store discount codes (not the billing `coupons`), stamp card, ordering funnel (unique per session/step/product/day) |
| `couriers` | Delivery people with a revocable token; orders carry `courier_id`, `delivered_at`, `courier_settled_at` |
| Lookup tables | `roles`, `restaurant_statuses`, `dish_statuses`, `video_statuses`, `video_origins`, `generation_statuses`, `generation_ledger_types`, `metrics_levels`, `discount_types`, `admin_actions` — slug-keyed (`IsLookupTable`) |

Invariants: one `dish_views` row per dish/session/day (`add_daily_unique_index_to_dish_views_table`); ledger `reference` used for idempotency; balances locked with `lockForUpdate()`.

### Storage

- Engine: MySQL 8.4 (Sail); `database/database.sqlite` file also present; tests use `RefreshDatabase`.
- Migrations: Laravel migrations; seeders `LookupSeeder`, `ReferenceDataSeeder`; factories in `database/factories`.
- Files: S3 via `config/filesystems.php` (`FILESYSTEM_DISK`); video on Mux.

### Cache

- Cache table migration exists (`0001_01_01_000001_create_cache_table`); `CACHE_STORE` env-driven; tests use `array`.
- Queue table `jobs` (`create_jobs_table`).
